mechanism_narrative: A high current federal funds rate (above historical averages) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate applied to future cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A nonfarm payrolls level above 155,000 thousand persons indicates a tight labor market that supports corporate profit growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when PAYEMS > 155000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) and strong payroll growth (PAYEMS > 155,000 thousand) signals an overheating labor market that accelerates inflation and triggers aggressive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0 and PAYEMS > 155000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions (as indicated by GDP level above 22,000 billion), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns due to heightened risk of a Fed policy pivot and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when GDPC1 > 22000, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector that depresses corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1,250,000 units (HOUST > 1250) signals robust consumer spending and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when HOUST > 1250, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 305 (current level) signals persistent inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain high interest rates, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 305, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales (RSAFS > 700,000 million) combined with robust industrial production (INDPRO > 100) indicates broad-based economic strength that boosts corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when RSAFS > 700000 and INDPRO > 100, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is <0.03.
